definition_zh: 投弹手；炮兵下士；（军）轰炸瞄准手；（昆虫）气步甲
definition_en: the aircrew member who aims and releases bombs, or an artillery soldier
core_image: 机头下舱里伏在瞄准镜上的投弹手
scene: 机腹的透明舱里，投弹手伏在瞄准具上默数秒。The bombardier lined up the target through the Norden sight.
sceneCN: 这里 bombardier 是「投弹手」（第 1 个义项：机上负责瞄准投弹的空勤人员）；句意是投弹手用诺顿瞄准具套准了目标。

pos.zh: 投弹手；炮兵下士；气步甲

derivatives.zh: 词根动词，义为「炮击；轰炸」

senses.title: The airman who releases the bombs
senses.definition: the bomber crew member who aims and drops the bombs
senses.definitionCN: 轰炸机机组中负责瞄准与投弹的成员
senses.example: The bombardier lined up the target through the Norden sight.
senses.exampleCN: 投弹手用诺顿瞄准具套准了目标。
senses.why: The old cannon officer's title moved into the aircraft with the bombs.
senses.whyCN: 旧日炮兵头衔随炸弹一起登上了飞机。

senses.title: An artillery NCO of the old British army
senses.definition: the British artillery rank equivalent to corporal
senses.definitionCN: 英国炮兵中相当于下士的军衔
senses.example: He was made a bombardier after the spring drills.
senses.exampleCN: 春季操练后他被提升为炮兵下士。
senses.why: Gunnery crews kept the old bombard as their rank root.
senses.whyCN: 炮组以古炮 bombard 为其军衔词根。

senses.title: The operator of a medieval bombard
senses.definition: the soldier who managed the early cannon called a bombard
senses.example: The castle's bombardiers fired the great guns at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 城堡的炮手在黎明时分开炮。
senses.why: The first sense: the man of the bombard, before flight existed.
senses.whyCN: 最初之义即「操作 bombard 之人」，远在飞机出现之前。

senses.title: The bombardier beetle
senses.definition: a beetle that sprays a hot chemical blast at attackers
senses.definitionCN: 遇敌喷射炽热化学雾的甲虫
senses.example: The bombardier beetle fires a boiling spray at frogs.
senses.exampleCN: 气步甲向青蛙喷射滚烫的化学雾。
senses.why: Its artillery-like defence earned it the gunner's name.
senses.whyCN: 它如炮击般的防御为它赢得了炮手之名。

senses.title: A company or trade title in transport
senses.definition: used in names of transport firms and craft, from the maker Bombardier
senses.definitionCN: 见于运输企业及载具名称（源自庞巴迪公司）
senses.example: He drives a Bombardier snowcoach across the ice field.
senses.exampleCN: 他驾驶庞巴迪雪地车穿越冰原。
senses.why: A surname of the trade became a brand, and the brand a common noun.
senses.whyCN: 行业姓氏成为品牌，品牌又化为普通名词。

senses.title: The lead bomb-aimer of a formation
senses.definition: the bombardier whose release signal drops the whole formation's bombs
senses.definitionCN: 其投放信号决定整个编队投弹的领队投弹手
senses.example: Every plane dropped when the lead bombardier released.
senses.exampleCN: 长机投弹手一投放，所有飞机齐齐投弹。
senses.why: Formations dropped together on one man's sight, concentrating the title's weight.
senses.whyCN: 编队凭一人镜中投放齐投，此职之名因此更重。

senses.title: Training and schools for the trade
senses.definition: the specialized schools that trained wartime bomb-aimers
senses.definitionCN: 战时培训投弹瞄准的专业学校体系
senses.example: She passed out top of her bombardier class.
senses.exampleCN: 她以投弹手班级第一的成绩毕业。
senses.why: The position demanded its own science and its own graduates.
senses.whyCN: 这一职位自成一科学问，故有专属学校与毕业生。

senses.title: Figurative director of an assault
senses.definition: a person who directs a barrage of any kind
senses.definitionCN: 主导任何形式「弹幕」的人
senses.example: As debate captain, she was the team's bombardier.
senses.exampleCN: 作为辩论队长，她是全队的「炮手」。
senses.why: Whoever commands the guns of a metaphor commands the name.
senses.whyCN: 谁执掌比喻中的火炮，谁便承袭其名。

intro.en: Bombardier is bombard plus the agent suffix -ier.
intro.cn: bombardier 由 bombard 加施动者后缀 -ier 构成。

items.en: bombus, a booming, underlies the family.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bombus「轰鸣」是整个词族的基底。

items.en: bombardier named the keeper of the great gun.
items.cn: 古法语 bombardier 指掌管巨炮之人。

items.en: English took the gunner's title for the early artillery.
items.cn: 英语于 16 世纪借入该炮手头衔。

items.en: it settled as the artillery corporal's rank.
items.cn: 该词在英国炮兵中定为下士军衔。

items.en: air warfare transferred it to the man at the bombsight; the beetle had already borrowed it.
items.cn: 20 世纪空战把它转给瞄准投弹者；而甲虫在此之前已借用了此名。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bombard root; the near-meaning group gathers gunner and gunner-adjacent words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bombard 词根；近义组收炮手类词。

entries.definition: a member of a gun crew
the forward gunner of a bomber

normalIntro.en: Bombardier is the man of the bombard, from cannon to bombsight.
normalIntro.cn: bombardier 即「操纵 bombard 之人」，从古炮到瞄准具。

normal.en: In the RAF, USAF, and US Army it means the bombs-aimer.
normal.cn: 在英、美军中它指投弹瞄准手。

normal.en: In the British artillery it is a corporal-equivalent rank.
normal.cn: 在英军炮兵中它相当于下士。

normal.en: Bombardier beetle is a standard insect name.
normal.cn: bombardier beetle 是标准的昆虫名。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with brigadier.

abstract.en: See the crosshairs drift onto a bridge from three kilometres up.
abstract.cn: 看三千米高空的十字线缓缓移向一座桥。

abstract.en: Hear the click as the bomb leaves its rack.
abstract.cn: 听炸弹离架时的一声轻响。

abstract.en: Picture a beetle aiming its glowing abdomen at your finger.
abstract.cn: 想象一只甲虫把发亮的腹部对准你的手指。

examples.en: The bombardier lined up the target through the Norden sight.
examples.cn: 投弹手用诺顿瞄准具套准了目标。

examples.en: He was made a bombardier after the spring drills.
examples.cn: 春季操练后他被提升为炮兵下士。

examples.en: The bombardier beetle fires a boiling spray at frogs.
examples.cn: 气步甲向青蛙喷射滚烫的化学雾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「蹦吧的儿」——管炮弹「蹦吧」作响的那位儿郎，就是投弹手。

root: bombard（源自拉丁语 bombus「轰鸣」，经古法语 bombarte「臼炮」）加法语施动者后缀 -ier；16 世纪进入英语指臼炮操作手，后定为英军炮兵下士衔，20 世纪转指轰炸机投弹瞄准手；气步甲因炮击式防御沿用此名。

sensesIntro.en: From the man behind the old bombard to the eyes behind the bombsight, bombardier has always meant master of the drop.
sensesIntro.cn: 从古炮的操作手到瞄准具后的眼睛，bombardier 始终意味着「投放的主宰」。

core.cn: 核心意象：瞄准具十字线缓缓套住一座桥

intro.cn: -ier 后缀造出「操作此物之人」。
